newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Heavy wins $150 mln India power plant order.
newsitem.headline: Korea Heavy wins $150 mln India power plant order.

text.p: South Korea's state-owned Korea Heavy Industries and Construction Corp said on Monday it had won a $150 million order from a unit of India 's ESBE Group to build a diesel-fuelled power plant in India.
The plant, to be built over 19 months finishing in July 1998, will have four 39.7-megawatt generators, making the plant's total capacity 158.8 megawatts, a Korea Heavy statement said.
The contract was signed between Korea Heavy and the ESBE Group unit, Scintilla Power Ltd, it said.
Korea Heavy hopes to win more power plant construction deals from India as the country plans to build plants with capacity totalling about 18,000 megawatts by the year 2002, the statement added.
